verdict.rationale: Glama's Gateway documentation states that every MCP call through the gateway URL is logged, and it markets this as letting you know exactly what your agents are doing. That is first-party support for a tool-call log. The evidence never describes what the log records, how to view or export it, or whether it is detailed enough to audit or replay an agent's actions. The Inspector's JSON-RPC protocol log is a testing tool, not a gateway audit trail, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented log contents (arguments, responses, identity, timestamps), a log viewing/search/export interface, replay capability, retention details, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see a log of every tool call that passed through the platform, with enough detail to audit or replay what an agent did

citations.quote: Every call through this URL is logged, access-controlled, and credential-managed
Every MCP call from your agents flows through Glama – so you know exactly what your AI is doing
